# `readDocument(input, [options.mimeType], [options.fileName], [options.maxChars], [options.maxPages])`

[External Documentation](https://github.com/rdsslab/libOpenFusionAPI) 

Extracts plain text from an in-memory document (Buffer, base64, data URL or `{ data, mimeType, fileName }`). Supports PDF (text layer), DOCX (in-memory ZIP) and text formats: TXT, MD, CSV, TSV, JSON, HTML, XML, YAML, LOG, SRT, VTT. No filesystem access is needed or allowed.

**Notes**

- Scanned PDFs have no text layer; `DocumentExtractionError` with code `PDF_NO_TEXT` tells the user to send images instead.
- XLSX, PPTX and other binary formats are not supported: the error includes a `userMessage` listing the supported ones.
- Nothing is written to disk: unzipping DOCX and parsing PDFs happens entirely in memory.

**Agent Guidance**

- Extract text yourself and inject it into the prompt; do not expose a path-based tool, there is no filesystem.
- Check `truncated` and tell the user when only part of the document was read.

**Parameters**

*   `input` <Buffer|string|object> Document bytes: Buffer, Uint8Array, ArrayBuffer, base64 string, data URL or `{ data, base64, dataUrl, mimeType, fileName }`.
*   `options.mimeType` <string> **Optional**. MIME type, used when the input carries no metadata.
*   `options.fileName` <string> **Optional**. File name, used to infer the format when `mimeType` is missing.
*   `options.maxChars` <integer> **Optional**. Default: `200000`. Maximum extracted characters before truncation.
*   `options.maxPages` <integer> **Optional**. Default: `60`. Maximum PDF pages to read.

*   Returns: <object> Extraction result.

    **Result Structure:**

    *   `ok` <boolean> Always true on success.
    *   `kind` <string> `pdf`, `docx`, `html` or `text`.
    *   `text` <string> Extracted plain text.
    *   `truncated` <boolean> True when `maxChars` cut the text.
    *   `pages` <integer> Total PDF pages (PDF only).
    *   `extractedPages` <integer> Pages actually read (PDF only).
    *   `chars` <integer> Total characters before truncation.
    *   `mimeType` <string> Resolved MIME type.
    *   `fileName` <string> Resolved file name.

#### Example

```javascript

const doc = await readDocument({
  data: $_BODY_.file.data,
  mimeType: $_BODY_.file.mimetype,
  fileName: $_BODY_.file.filename,
}, { maxChars: 40000 });

$_RETURN_DATA_ = { chars: doc.chars, preview: doc.text.slice(0, 500) };
      
```
